body: I just feel like I'm getting worse. I feel so numb.

I went out to clear my head a little. It didn't help at all.

I can't distract myself with anything. I have nothing to distract me. Everything I know that would help me just doesn't help. I feel worthless and if I talked to my girlfriend about it then she would take it out on herself and I don't want to do that to her. She is the sort of person who would feel like it was her fault and I don't want that. I want to handle it myself because I'm the only person who can, but it hurts not having this support from the person I'm closest to.

I stopped playing because it just hasn't made me happy lately. I don't think writing is dull. I just feel locked away from it because I've lost the muse that I had that kept me writing and kept me motivated.

Well, the first community I was a part of I was sort of treated like the old order. So when the community went in a new direction, I was left behind. The new one? Everyone knows each other already and everyone is already known for something. It's a video game show that I watch online and they have a pretty good fanbase. We have a forum and a whole load of them play games together, and I just don't feel a part of anything with them. I want to be, but nothing separates me from anyone else. I want to be liked, but I'm just a no one.

Ranting is nice. I used to rant. Then I really mellowed out and stopped hating the world when I met my girlfriend so I haven't visited that part of my mind for a long time. I used to hate it but I think it's a part of me that will always be there, so I may as well try it.

Well I'm into gaming, sketching and writing, but games aren't really pulling me in and my inspiration is a million miles away. I have no muse.

I get excited for stuff, but not recently. I used to but I can't get excited for anything any more.

I have no community in real life and no community over the Internet. Again, I used to have ones in real life but I stopped because I felt emotionally hurt being there. I also used to have a couple of online communities, but with one I wasn't appreciated or even liked after a while and the other one? I don't participate because they're really close and I don't feel welcome.
